messages.author: 834e57a4194bb8dc
messages.subject: Not getting the bars
parts:
Colleagues …

 

Given the data structure readmelt2010, why is the ggplot code below not drawing the bars?  In this data frame the y values run approximately 1-3, but I’m going to produce other plots with y values 1-5, so I put all the points on the y-scale in this one to ease comparisons across graphs.

 

readmelt2010 <- structure(list(KING = structure(c(2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L,

1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L,

1L), class = "factor", .Label = c("King", "Other")), grade = c(3L,

3L, 4L, 4L, 5L, 5L, 6L, 6L, 7L, 7L, 8L, 8L, 3L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 5L,

5L, 6L, 6L, 7L, 7L, 8L, 8L), variable = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L,

1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L,

2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L), .Label = c("first", "final"), class = "factor"),

    value = c(2.246045589, 2, 2.200811386, 1.615384579, 2.34320569,

    2.210526228, 2.460348129, 2.055555582, 2.481203079, 2.299999952,

    2.438972235, 2.294117689, 2.81722331, 2.692307711, 2.811358929,

    2.384615421, 2.942508698, 2.684210539, 2.833655596, 2.388888836,

    2.992481232, 2.900000095, 2.920770884, 2.764705896)), .Names = c("KING",

"grade", "variable", "value"), row.names = c(NA, -24L), class = "data.frame")

 

r2010 <- ggplot(readmelt2010, aes(x = factor(grade), y = value, fill = variable)) +

         theme_bw()  +

         theme(panel.border = element_blank(),

            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +

         theme(legend.text=element_text(size = 12)) +

         theme(legend.position = "top")             +

         guides(fill=guide_legend(title = NULL)) +

         geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +

         scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1,5), breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), labels = c("Very Low", "Low",

            "Near", "Meets", "Exceeds")) +

        labs(title = "2010/11",

            x = "Grade", y = "Proficiency Level") +

        theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.2))) +

        theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),

             panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +

        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +

        theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +

        theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +

        theme(axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +

        scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("First Attempt", "Retest") )  

r2010 + facet_grid( . ~ KING)

 

Thanks!

Art

messages.subject: Re: Not getting the bars
parts: You could modify your call to the following (The commented line is where the change is)

r2010 <- ggplot(readmelt2010, aes(x = factor(grade), y = value, fill = variable)) +
  theme_bw()  +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size = 12)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")             +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title = NULL)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,5),breaks = 0:5, labels = c("","Very Low", "Low","Near", "Meets", "Exceeds")) + # CHANGED HERE

labs(title = "2010/11",
       x = "Grade", y = "Proficiency Level") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.2))) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2))) +
  scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("First Attempt", "Retest") )  
r2010 + facet_grid( . ~ KING)
